summary: Precision Drilling Corporation furnished a Form 6-K attaching an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated September 29, 2026, announcing that its 2026 third quarter results will be released after market close on October 27, 2026, with a conference call and webcast scheduled for 11:00 a.m. MT (1:00 p.m. ET) on October 28, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, shareholder solicitation, or special-situation event; it is a routine earnings-scheduling notice. Registration and webcast links were provided. No terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed.
